python3 - <<'PY'
import os,shlex,json,subprocess,tomllib
from pathlib import Path
hosts=tomllib.loads((Path.home()/'.config/host-ops/config.toml').read_text())['hosts']
root=Path.home()/'.cache/photomap-rsync-relay-20261101-v1'
print("MAC_STAGE="+json.dumps({'exists':root.is_dir(),'symlink':root.is_symlink(),'db_exists':(root/'data/app.db').exists(),'known_hosts':(root/'adb_usb_known_hosts').exists()}),flush=True)
if root.is_dir():
 p=subprocess.run(['du','-sh',str(root)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=35)
 print("MAC_STAGE_SIZE="+p.stdout.strip(),flush=True)
def sshargs(h):
 return ['ssh','-i',str(Path(h['identity_file']).expanduser()),'-p',str(h['port']),'-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','IdentitiesOnly=yes','-o','StrictHostKeyChecking=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=9']
def exec_host(h,script,timeout=75):
 p=subprocess.run(sshargs(h)+[str(h['user'])+'@'+str(h['host']),'bash -c '+shlex.quote(script)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
 return {'rc':p.returncode,'out':p.stdout[-6500:],'err':p.stderr[-650:]}
pi=r'''set -u
D=/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps/.dev/rsync-export-20261101-v1
echo EXPORT_EXISTS=$(test -d "$D" && echo yes || echo no)
test -d "$D" && { du -sh "$D"; find "$D" -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%P %s bytes\n'; sha256sum "$D/app.db"; } || true
echo PROD_HEALTH=$(curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8000/health)
echo PROD_SERVICE=$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)
echo PROD_CF=$(systemctl is-active cloudflared.service)
'''
print("PI="+json.dumps(exec_host(hosts['pi-zero'],pi),ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
rows=subprocess.run(['adb','devices','-l'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20).stdout.splitlines()[1:]
usb=[row.split()[0] for row in rows if len(row.split())>1 and row.split()[1]=='device' and ':' not in row.split()[0]]
print("USB_COUNT="+str(len(usb)),flush=True)
assert len(usb)==1 and root.is_dir() and (root/'adb_usb_known_hosts').is_file()
serial=usb[0]
f=subprocess.run(['adb','-s',serial,'forward','tcp:18122','tcp:8022'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
assert f.returncode==0,f.stderr
try:
 phone=r'''set -u
D="$HOME/Projects/PhotoMap/.dev/termux"
for p in "$D/data/app.db" "$D/import-pi-20261101-v1" "$D/rollback-prepi-20261101-v1" "$D/pi-import-active-20261101-v1.json" "$D/process/runit/photomap-dev" "$PREFIX/var/service/photomap-dev"; do
 if test -e "$p" || test -L "$p"; then ls -ld "$p"; else echo "ABSENT=$p"; fi
done
echo PHOTOMAP_DB_SHA=$(sha256sum "$D/data/app.db" | cut -d' ' -f1)
for kind in private public; do echo "ACTIVE_$kind=$(find "$D/storage/$kind" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"; done
echo PHOTO_HEALTH=$(curl -sS -m 6 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8010/health)
echo ILESTOI_HEALTH=$(curl -sS -m 6 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/health/ready)
echo SERVICE=$(sv status "$PREFIX/var/service/photomap-dev" 2>&1)
printf 'PHOTO_PROCS_BEGIN\n'
ps -A -o pid,ppid,comm,args | grep -E '[p]hotomap-dev|[/]mnt/server.py' | cut -c1-150 | head -n 8 || true
echo PHOTO_PROCS_END
'''
 a=['ssh','-i',str(Path(hosts['termux-phone']['identity_file']).expanduser()),'-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','IdentitiesOnly=yes','-o','StrictHostKeyChecking=yes','-o','UserKnownHostsFile='+str(root/'adb_usb_known_hosts'),'-o','ConnectTimeout=9','-p','18122',str(hosts['termux-phone']['user'])+'@127.0.0.1','bash -c '+shlex.quote(phone)]
 p=subprocess.run(a,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=115)
 print("PHONE="+json.dumps({'rc':p.returncode,'out':p.stdout[-7000:],'err':p.stderr[-800:]},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
finally:
 subprocess.run(['adb','-s',serial,'forward','--remove','tcp:18122'],capture_output=True,timeout=20)
PY
